title: Weak Seams
text: Weak Seams. I opened this new set of bags, and ended up using 6 when 2 normally would have worked.  Four of the bags ruptured along the seam while piping.  I was only trying to decorate two dozen mini cupcakes, and have never had bags fail like this before, even when decorating much greater quantities.  I have only used Wilton decorating bags, so I'm not sure why I'm having issues with these.
